title: JuControler role x runtime AI auto-assignment
description: Read-only record of the ordered runtime choices for each harness role. Subscribed runtimes come first; free models from already-installed tools follow as the backup used when a limit or failure is hit or the work is light. An assignment names an order; it does not dispatch work, install tools, or create accounts.

assignments.description: One entry per role; every role pm, worker, qa, and tester appears exactly once.

role.description: Harness role the runtimes are ordered for. Role is not Runtime.

choices.description: Runtime choices in try order. Every subscribed entry comes before every free entry.

permissions.description: Explicit read-only permissions. Every field is fixed; there is no writable variant.

dispatch.description: Must not dispatch, send to, or control agents, runtimes, or managed work.

install.description: Must not install a tool or model; free choices only name tools already installed.

createAccount.description: Must not sign up for, subscribe to, or create any provider account.

runtime.description: Agent runtime identifier, e.g. claude-code, codex, opencode.

tier.description: subscribed: a runtime the Founder already pays for, tried first. free: a free model from an already-installed tool, the backup on a limit, a failure, or light work.
